topic_thesis: Listed Indian manufacturing giants quietly pass an 11-13% cumulative price hike onto consumers over two quarters under the guise of raw material inflation to artificially pump operating margins.
strategic_angle: Expose the corporate earnings playbook reported by brokerage trackers: companies hike prices by 7-9% in Q1 and another 3-4% in Q2, passing 100% of input costs to consumers while retail investors blindly buy the stock at all-time highs thinking margin growth is from operational efficiency.
target_emotion: Outrage at corporate margin extraction and retail investor blind spots
pinned_comment_text: Are you paying 12% more for products just so listed companies can show inflated quarterly profits? Comment 'TRUTH' to get our breakdown on real company operating margins vs retail price hikes! 💬👇
